details.label: Status
details.text: first seen Nov 14 13:48 UTC. It failed in 8 of 8 completed runs of this job on image `rocm10-mi35x-20261114`: 1 scheduled run and 7 PR runs. The job passed in 15 of 15 earlier runs, the last one at 06:14 on `-20261113` `[FACT]`.

details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` [#49603](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/49603) ([`4a4f4000`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/4a4f400022105aca91bddd5d1d5af814ca59bbb1)) moved the ROCm image from UCX `v1.19.x` to UCX master `929abbb`, and moved NIXL to `c656976f`.
About 0.6 s after `NIXL KVManager initialized with backend: UCX`, the decode scheduler hits `hipErrorOutOfMemory` on its first stream use, while PyTorch still reports 29 GB free.
The workflow already works around the same symptom for Mooncake with `MOONCAKE_DISABLE_HIP_DMABUF=1`.

The commit is in the `-20261114` image (built at [`233d6bae`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/233d6bae87f218e4f667e4618fe4a674770d7422)) and not in `-20261113` (built at [`6c29aa59`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/6c29aa5954a0dab3c2f8a23835fabda5d759947d)) `[FACT]`.

details.label: Disconfirming
details.text: the PR was validated on 2-node TP8 with RDMA, and this test runs TP1 within one node. Other parts of the image changed too and were not compared.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ❌ none found (searched `nixl`, `ucx`, `test_nixl_transfer_engine`).

details.label: Suggested triage
details.text: rebuild with `UCX_BRANCH=v1.19.x` only, then with `NIXL_COMMIT=c28061f9` only. Or try UCX settings on the current image (drop `rocm_ipc` from `UCX_TLS`).
